_verified: pip install minihack (needs setuptools<81 for pkg_resources; downgrades gymnasium to 1.2). Runs via the 'minihack' backend: pixel observation displayed, Discrete(8) compass (arrows=N/E/S/W), blstats/glyphs/message logged. No savestate (seed+replay).
_keys_note: Discrete(8) compass action space: 0=N,1=E,2=S,3=W,4=NE,5=SE,6=SW,7=NW. Arrows map to the cardinals; Y/A/B/X to the diagonals NW/NE/SW/SE. turn_based:true is required -- noop is action 0 (=move N), so a real-time loop would auto-walk north. Keep the message Controls text in sync with 'keys' by hand.

text: Explore the room and step onto the down-staircase
ARROWS       move  N / S / W / E
Y / A        move diagonally  NW / NE
B / X        move diagonally  SW / SE

curriculum._note: Many env ids (MiniHack-Room-*, MiniHack-MazeWalk-*, MiniHack-River-*, ...). Diagonals via Y/A/B/X; extra commands per scenario (see minihack__corridor / minihack__eat).
